Extracts keywords, author, viewport, generator, theme-color, robots, lang, dir metadata

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	pkg "github.com/xberg-io/crawlberg/packages/go"
)

func main() {
	engine, createErr := pkg.CreateEngine(nil)
	if createErr != nil {
		panic(fmt.Sprintf("create handle failed: %v", createErr))
	}
	url := `https://example.com`
	result, err := pkg.Scrape(engine, url)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.StatusCode)
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Metadata.Title)
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Metadata.CanonicalURL)
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Metadata.Keywords)
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Metadata.Author)
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Metadata.Viewport)
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Metadata.Generator)
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Metadata.ThemeColor)
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Metadata.Robots)
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Metadata.HTMLLang)
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Metadata.HTMLDir)
}
```
